exposure: Fetal head position (occiput anterior, transverse, posterior)
outcome: Incidence of malpositions and deflexed cephalic malpresentations at the beginning of the second stage of labor
cohort: 200 women in labor with a singleton pregnancy at term with fetuses in a cephalic presentation at 10 cm of cervical dilatation
finding: Sonographic diagnosis of fetal head deflexion at the beginning of the second stage of labor was an independent risk factor for cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Fetal head deflexion was significantly associated with cesarean delivery in both occiput anterior and occiput posterior fetuses.
birth_weight: Recorded, but specific values not mentioned.
